prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all change types (sign_in hint, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, home wait_info, choose_path layout) as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split-Screen Pet Trait Preview Layout: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout that showcases real-time personality traits and live animations alongside choice options. (why: Adoption step has a 39.1% drop-off rate and a high median time of 89s, indicating users struggle to compare pet options.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Quick Guide Screen: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right before completion detailing desktop shortcuts, drag behaviors, and pet interaction menus. (why: Support logs contain multiple reports of user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet following onboarding.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Real-Time Photo Rendering Preview Flow: Introduce an instant visual rendering feedback preview when users upload custom pet photos before proceeding. (why: Support received reports where custom pet creation failed or resulted in distorted renderings after photo uploads.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Save Reorder: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation so users build emotional ownership before account creation. (why: Sign-in drop-off is 23.1%; asking users to sign in after customizing their pet leverages commitment bias and clarifies save state benefit.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Estimate & Progress: Show live generation progress steps alongside an estimated countdown timer during pet synthesis. (why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to believe the process has frozen.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Background Ready Desktop Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during long renders. (why: Extreme mean time on home screen (2336s) suggests users switch windows while waiting and miss when setup completes.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Choice Cards Layout: Organize onboarding path choices into prominent visual cards detailing estimated setup times and path outcomes. (why: Choose path has a drop-off rate of 23.8% and high mean duration (514s), indicating choice uncertainty.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Launch Permission Guidance Copy: Update finish headline and body text to clearly explain desktop overlay permission requirements and spawn actions. (why: Support mail reported issues where pets did not appear on the desktop overlay or app failed to open properly.)
